short_description: CAPSCam (Carnegie Astrometric Planet Search Camera) z, du Pont

licence.scope: Site-wide footer (rule 3) of the Las Campanas Observatory website, operated by Carnegie Science, the owner of the observatory; the footer is the only terms statement found there (https://www.lco.cl/?epkb_post_type_1=capscam is the LCO page cited or linked for CAPSCam). It says nothing specific about filter curves, so the class is restricted. SVO's cited source page: http://www.lco.cl/telescopes-information/irenee-du-pont/instruments/website/capscam/capscam-users-manual#section_5.4 (now 404). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
